premise: After being abandoned at the altar, a disgraced noblewoman marries a scarred stranger, unknowingly tying her fate to a presumed-dead duke seeking vengeance.

reveals.reveal: A scarred stranger intervenes at the cathedral and proposes to the disowned Juliana.
Gerald Harrington hired thugs to destroy Juliana's herbal garden.
Rupert usurped the ducal seat while holding Alexander's mother prisoner.
The Dowager Duchess is being slowly poisoned with arsenic rather than dying of natural causes.
The Dowager Duchess recognizes the Ashbourne crest on Juliana's ring, linking her husband to the lost duke.
Alexander was betrayed on the Iberian front by traitors within Ashwood.
Alexander appears in full ducal regalia at Rupert's wedding, revealing he is alive and the rightful Duke.
Crown intelligence reports expose Lord Sterling and Rupert Ashburn as traitors who sold Alexander's military unit to the enemy.
The High Priest declares Alexander and Juliana's marriage invalid due to the lack of a royal ducal license.
